headline.falsifiable_claim: The P5 MIN-REPORT honesty surface has THREE orthogonal axes. (A) per-axis score on the harvest surface is a ceiling at 16.67/16.67 for all 6 audit axes (n=98 cells, 100.0% match on every declared value). (B) per-item match rate on the registry surface varies 100pp across the 32 (entry, delta, component) rows but per-item aggregation shows 0/7 items have B_n_audited > 5, underscoring that B operates at finer granularity. (C) per-item Shannon entropy on the standard classifies 4/7 items as VACUOUS, 2/7 as MEDIUM, 1/7 as HIGH. The three audits do not jointly single out a 'bad item' because A is uniform and B is sparse at item level; the actionable signal lives in C, which shows MIN-REPORT items 1, 2, 3, 7 are themselves informatively vacuous on the current 98-cell corpus.
